title: Lee stresses need for Seoul to take lead on peninsular affairs after Trump-Xi-Putin meeting
caption:
South Korean President Lee Jae Myung stated that Seoul must direct diplomacy regarding the Korean Peninsula following talks between Donald Trump, Xi Jinping, and Vladimir Putin. The administration stressed that outside superpowers will not decide the nation's strategic future.
